Communication Committee Meeting Monday, 

August 17, 2026 10am South Boardroom and Zoom

Agenda 1. Call meeting to order 2. Roll Call 3. Approve agenda 4. Approve 

June 8, 2026 minutes 5. Announcement: Chair's resignation effective at adjournment 6. Welcome new Committee member and Link Editor 7. Committee Reports a. Webmaster – Gail Stott b. Web Admin – Jean Stjernstrom c. The Link – Lisa Bria d. Liaison/Zoom – Chuck Silcox e. Community Channel – Chuck Silcox f. Online Activity Calendar – Teri Bach and Jean Stjernstrom g. PH Weekly e-newsletter – Steve Leonowicz i. Motion to move the issue to the board to approve new e-newsletter 8. Unfinished Business: a. Status of updating minutes folders on webpage 9.
